newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-SPURS FIRE HEAD COACH HILL, GM POPOVICH TAKES OVER.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-SPURS FIRE HEAD COACH HILL, GM POPOVICH TAKES OVER.

text.p: The San Antonio Spurs fired head coach Bob Hill on Tuesday, hours before superstar centre David Robinson was scheduled to make his season debut.
Hill will be replaced by general manager Gregg Popovich for Tuesday night's game against the Phoenix Suns. The team did not specify whether Popovich was serving as an interim coach.
The Spurs are in sixth place in the NBA's Midwest Division with a 3-15 record and have lost 10 of their last 11 games.
The firing comes as Robinson, one of the NBA's premier players, has finally been cleared to play after being sidelined with a lower back strain.

Hill was 124-58 (.681) in two-plus seasons with the Spurs, who were 62-20 in 1994-95 and 59-23 last year. He has a career record of 257-212 (.548 winning percentage) in parts of seven NBA seasons as coach of the Spurs, Indiana Pacers and New York Knicks.
In his first season in San Antonio, the team registered the NBA's best record but lost in the Western Conference finals to the Houston Rockets, who went on to win the NBA championship.
The Spurs won the division title in 1995-96 for the second straight season, but the Spurs lost in the second round of the playoffs to the Utah Jazz.
